ko.title: 진정 전 준비부터 치료 후 회복 확인까지
ko.intro: 진정치료는 건강 상태와 치료 범위에 맞게 계획하고, 치료 중과 회복 과정에 상태를 계속 관찰합니다. 진정 방법에 따라 효과와 주의 사항이 다르며 통증이나 위험이 모두 없어지는 것은 아닙니다.

steps.title: 사전 평가와 준비
steps.text: 병력·복용약과 치료 내용을 확인하고 방법에 맞는 준비와 주의 사항을 안내합니다.

steps.title: 진정 시작과 관찰
steps.text: 계획한 감시 장치를 연결하고 반응·호흡 등 상태를 살피며 진정을 시행합니다.

steps.title: 관찰을 이어가며 진료
steps.text: 치과 처치 동안 반응과 호흡 등 환자 상태를 계속 살피고, 선택한 진정 방법에 필요한 감시를 이어갑니다.

steps.title: 회복 확인과 귀가 안내
steps.text: 치료 후 회복을 평가하고 실제 안내에 따라 동반자·활동·귀가와 이후 연락 방법을 설명합니다.

ko.followup: 회복과 이후 주의 사항은 실제 진정 방법에 따른 안내를 따르며 이상 증상은 안내받은 연락처로 문의합니다.

en.title: Preparation, monitored care and recovery
en.intro: Sedation is planned around health and treatment needs, with continued observation during care and recovery. Effects and precautions depend on the method; sedation does not eliminate all pain or risk.

steps.title: Assess and prepare
steps.text: Review health, medicines and treatment, and provide preparation instructions for the selected method.

steps.title: Begin sedation and monitoring
steps.text: Apply planned monitoring and observe responsiveness, breathing and other relevant signs.

steps.title: Continue monitored care
steps.text: Throughout dental treatment, the team observes responsiveness, breathing and other relevant signs, with monitoring appropriate to the sedation method.

steps.title: Review recovery and discharge
steps.text: Assess recovery and provide individual escort, activity, discharge and contact guidance.

en.followup: Follow recovery instructions for the actual sedation method and use the provided contact route for unexpected symptoms.

ja.title: 鎮静前の準備から回復の確認まで
ja.intro: 鎮静は健康状態と治療内容に合わせて計画し、処置中から回復まで状態を継続して観察します。方法によって効果と注意点が異なり、痛みやリスクがすべてなくなるわけではありません。

steps.title: 事前評価と準備
steps.text: 病歴、薬、治療内容を確認し、選択した方法の準備を説明します。

steps.title: 鎮静と監視の開始
steps.text: 必要な監視を行い、反応や呼吸などを観察します。

steps.title: 観察を続けた診療
steps.text: 歯科処置中も反応や呼吸などを観察し、選択した鎮静方法に必要な監視を続けます。

steps.title: 回復と帰宅の案内
steps.text: 回復を評価し、付き添い、活動、帰宅、連絡方法を個別に説明します。

ja.followup: 実際に用いた鎮静法に応じた回復時の指示に従い、異常な症状は案内された連絡先に相談します。

rows.name: 턱의 증상을 평가하고 보존적 관리부터 검토하기
scopeFlags: 턱관절장애는 여러 질환을 포함하며 특정 원판 정복을 일반 치료 목표처럼 그리지 않음.

ko.title: 턱의 증상을 평가하고 보존적 관리부터 검토하기
ko.intro: 턱관절장애는 관절과 근육의 여러 문제를 포함합니다. 소리가 난다는 이유만으로 치료를 정하거나 관절원판을 반드시 되돌리는 과정을 일반화하지 않습니다.

steps.title: 증상과 기능 평가
steps.text: 통증·잠김·움직임과 병력을 확인하고 다른 원인 가능성을 살핍니다. 통증 없는 소리만으로 치료가 필요한 것은 아닙니다.

steps.title: 부담을 줄이는 기본 관리
steps.text: 평가에 맞춰 턱에 부담을 주는 습관을 줄이고 편안한 범위의 관리 방법을 익힙니다.

steps.title: 필요한 보존적 치료 선택
steps.text: 상태에 따라 적절한 비수술적 방법을 검토합니다. 장치나 특정 방법 하나의 효과를 모두에게 보장하지 않습니다.

steps.title: 경과를 확인해 조정
steps.text: 통증과 기능을 다시 평가하고 필요하면 계획을 바꾸거나 추가 평가를 합니다.

ko.followup: 통증과 기능의 변화를 확인하고 필요하면 보존적 관리나 추가 평가 계획을 조정합니다.

en.title: Assess jaw symptoms and consider conservative care
en.intro: TMD includes several joint and muscle conditions. A sound alone does not determine treatment, and disc repositioning is not a universal goal.

steps.title: Assess symptoms and function
steps.text: Review pain, locking, movement and history. Painless sounds alone may not need treatment.

steps.title: Reduce avoidable strain
steps.text: Learn suitable habits and comfortable management based on the assessment.

steps.title: Select indicated conservative care
steps.text: Consider appropriate non-surgical options without promising one method works for everyone.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.text: Reassess pain and function, then adjust the plan or arrange further evaluation.

en.followup: Changes in pain and function guide adjustments to conservative care or further assessment.

ja.title: 顎の症状を評価し保存的管理を検討する
ja.intro: 顎関節症には関節や筋の複数の問題があります。音だけで治療を決めたり、円板の復位を共通の目標にしたりしません。

steps.title: 症状と機能の評価
steps.text: 痛み、ロック、動き、病歴を確認します。痛みのない音だけでは治療不要な場合があります。

steps.title: 負担を減らす基本管理
steps.text: 評価に合う習慣と無理のない管理方法を学びます。

steps.title: 必要な保存的治療
steps.text: 適切な非手術的方法を検討します。一つの方法の効果を全員に保証しません。

steps.title: 経過と計画の調整
steps.text: 痛みと機能を再評価し、計画変更や追加評価を行います。

ja.followup: 痛みと機能の変化を確認し、保存的な管理や追加評価の計画を必要に応じて調整します。

ko.title: 색과 적합성을 확인한 뒤 진행하는 미백
ko.intro: 미백은 치아 색을 밝게 하는 방법이며 치아 형태를 바꾸거나 모든 수복물의 색을 함께 바꾸는 치료가 아닙니다. 방법과 반응, 시림은 개인별로 달라집니다.

steps.title: 색과 적용 가능성 평가
steps.text: 원래 색과 수복물, 치아·잇몸 상태를 확인하고 적합한 방법과 기대 범위를 설명합니다.

steps.title: 연조직 보호와 적용
steps.text: 선택한 방법에 맞게 잇몸 등을 보호하고 필요한 부위에 미백 재료를 적용합니다.

steps.title: 정해진 적용 뒤 제거
steps.text: 선택한 방법과 재료에 정해진 적용 과정을 거친 뒤 미백 재료를 제거합니다. 치아 색의 변화와 필요한 기간은 개인마다 달라집니다.

steps.title: 색과 불편감 확인
steps.text: 같은 조명 조건에서 색과 반응을 확인하고 시림 등 불편감과 이후 관리 방법을 안내합니다.

ko.followup: 색과 시림·잇몸 자극을 확인하고 추가 미백이나 유지 방법은 반응에 따라 결정합니다.

en.title: Assess suitability before whitening
en.intro: Whitening changes tooth shade, not tooth shape or every existing restoration. Method, response and sensitivity vary.

steps.title: Assess shade and suitability
steps.text: Review baseline shade, restorations and oral condition to discuss the method and expectations.

steps.title: Protect and apply
steps.text: Protect soft tissues and apply material according to the selected method.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.text: Follow the application process specified for the selected method and material, then remove the whitening material. Shade change and the time required vary between individuals.

steps.title: Review shade and comfort
steps.text: Assess shade under comparable lighting, discuss sensitivity and plan aftercare.

en.followup: Shade, sensitivity and gingival irritation are reviewed before deciding on further whitening or maintenance.

ja.title: 色と適合性を確認して行うホワイトニング
ja.intro: 歯の色を明るくする方法で、形やすべての修復物の色を変える治療ではありません。方法、反応、知覚過敏には個人差があります。

steps.title: 色と適合性の評価
steps.text: 元の色、修復物、口腔状態を確認し、方法と期待範囲を説明します。

steps.title: 軟組織の保護と適用
steps.text: 方法に応じて歯肉などを保護し、材料を適用します。

steps.title: 適用後の除去
steps.text: 選択した方法と材料に定められた適用過程を経て、ホワイトニング材を除去します。色の変化や必要な期間には個人差があります。

steps.title: 色と不快感の確認
steps.text: 同じ照明条件で色と反応を確認し、知覚過敏や管理を説明します。

ja.followup: 色調と知覚過敏・歯肉の刺激を確認し、反応に応じて追加のホワイトニングや管理方法を決めます。

ko.title: 주변 구조를 확인하고 필요한 사랑니를 발치하기
ko.intro: 사랑니는 위치와 문제 여부를 보고 발치를 판단합니다. 아래 과정은 접근과 분할이 필요한 발치의 한 예이며, 모든 사랑니가 발치나 분할 대상은 아닙니다.

steps.title: 위치와 접근 범위 평가
steps.text: 인접 치아와 주변 구조를 확인하고 필요한 접근 방법을 계획합니다.

steps.title: 필요한 접근과 분할
steps.text: 마취 등 준비 후 필요한 범위로 접근하고, 경우에 따라 치아를 나누어 제거할 경로를 만듭니다.

steps.title: 치아 제거와 부위 확인
steps.text: 계획한 경로로 치아 또는 조각을 제거하고 발치 부위를 확인합니다.

steps.title: 지혈·봉합과 회복 관리
steps.text: 필요하면 봉합하고 지혈과 청결, 주의 사항을 안내합니다. 발치 직후 상처가 완전히 아문 것은 아닙니다.

ko.followup: 출혈·통증·부기 등 회복 양상을 확인하며 안내받은 관리와 재진 계획을 따릅니다.

en.title: Assess the surroundings and remove a wisdom tooth when indicated
en.intro: Position and associated problems guide the decision to remove a wisdom tooth. The pathway below is one extraction requiring access and sectioning; not every wisdom tooth needs removal or division.

steps.title: Assess position and access
steps.text: Review adjacent teeth and surrounding anatomy to plan the approach.

steps.title: Access and section if needed
steps.text: After preparation, create the required access and divide the tooth when indicated.

steps.title: Remove and inspect
steps.text: Remove the tooth or accounted-for pieces along the planned path, then inspect the socket.

steps.title: Protect the wound and recover
steps.text: Provide haemostasis, sutures when needed and recovery guidance; immediate closure is not complete healing.

en.followup: Recovery, including bleeding, pain and swelling, is reviewed alongside the provided care and follow-up plan.

ja.title: 周囲を確認し必要な親知らずを抜歯する
ja.intro: 親知らずの位置と問題の有無から抜歯を判断します。以下はアクセスと分割が必要な抜歯の一例で、すべての親知らずが抜歯や分割の対象ではありません。

steps.title: 位置とアクセスの評価
steps.text: 隣の歯や周囲構造を確認して方法を計画します。

steps.title: 必要なアクセスと分割
steps.text: 準備後、必要な範囲にアクセスし、適応に応じて歯を分割します。

steps.title: 除去と部位の確認
steps.text: 計画した経路で歯や確認された断片を除去し、抜歯窩を確認します。

steps.title: 止血・縫合と回復管理
steps.text: 必要な止血や縫合を行い、回復の注意を説明します。直後は治癒完了ではありません。

ja.followup: 出血・痛み・腫れなどの回復経過を確認し、案内されたケアと再診計画に従います。

aae-root.title: AAE Root canal
aae-root.scopeAndLimits: 치수 조직 제거·세척소독·충전밀폐·최종 복원의 큰 흐름.

aae-surgery.title: AAE Endodontic surgery
aae-surgery.scopeAndLimits: 치근단 접근·병소/치근 끝 처치·역충전·봉합의 일반 흐름.

aap-nonsurgical.title: AAP Non-surgical treatments
aap-nonsurgical.scopeAndLimits: 치은연하 처치, 반응 평가와 유지 관리. 상세 수술 프로토콜 근거는 아님.

aao-braces.title: AAO Braces
aao-braces.scopeAndLimits: 진단·장치·조정·유지. 원내 패키지·제품 사양 근거는 아님.

aao-aligners.title: AAO Clear aligners
aao-aligners.scopeAndLimits: 맞춤 장치의 순차적 이동·개인별 계획·중간 확인. 패키지별 기간·횟수 근거는 아님.

fda-implant.title: FDA Dental implants
fda-implant.scopeAndLimits: 임플란트 구조·적합성·치유·위험·관리. 각 특수 술식의 상세 프로토콜은 별도 확인 필요.

nidcr-tmd.title: NIDCR TMD
nidcr-tmd.scopeAndLimits: 증상·감별 평가와 보존적 치료 한계. 구강내과의 모든 질환에 적용 불가.

ada-sealants.title: ADA Sealants
ada-sealants.scopeAndLimits: 실란트 예방의 일반 개념. 재료별 전처리·경화 처방은 별도 확인.

nhs-wisdom.title: NHS Wisdom tooth removal
nhs-wisdom.scopeAndLimits: 검사·상황별 접근과 이후 관리의 일반 흐름.

nhs-treatment.title: NHS Dental treatments
nhs-treatment.scopeAndLimits: 수복·보철의 일반 목적. 재료별 접착·중합의 상세 프로토콜 검증은 아님.

ada-sedation.title: ADA Anesthesia and sedation
ada-sedation.scopeAndLimits: 병력·건강·불안·시술에 따른 선택과 위험 논의. 원내 약물·인력·회복 기준은 별도 확인.

aae-avulsion.title: AAE Knocked-out teeth
aae-avulsion.scopeAndLimits: 탈락치 취급과 신속한 평가. 모든 치과 응급상황을 설명하는 자료는 아님.

nidcr-bruxism.title: NIDCR Bruxism
nidcr-bruxism.scopeAndLimits: 이갈이 평가·관리 개념. 장치에 의한 완치 보장 근거 아님.

aapd-restorative.title: AAPD Pediatric restorative dentistry
aapd-restorative.scopeAndLimits: 소아 수복 적응증과 개별 판단. 전체 소아치과를 기성관 하나로 대표하는 근거 아님.

ada-composite.title: ADA — Tooth-colored fillings
ada-composite.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
ada-composite.scopeAndLimits: Composite material overview; does not establish a particular adhesive/cure protocol or clinic outcome.

leeds-partial.title: Leeds NHS — Removable partial dentures
leeds-partial.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
leeds-partial.scopeAndLimits: Prosthetic options and care; tooth-supported bridge details also use the NHS dental treatments source.

nhs-denture.title: NHS — Dentures
nhs-denture.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
nhs-denture.scopeAndLimits: Impressions, fabrication, fitting and adjustment; detailed jaw registration and wax trial supported by leeds-complete.

cuh-implants.title: Cambridge NHS — Dental implants in restorative dentistry
cuh-implants.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
cuh-implants.scopeAndLimits: Placement, conditional augmentation, healing, prosthetic connection and maintenance; not brand CAD or clinic package terms.

leeds-implant.title: Leeds NHS — Dental implants
leeds-implant.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
leeds-implant.scopeAndLimits: Bone/soft-tissue planning, staged procedures, fixed and removable implant restorations; no fixed timeline adopted.

cuh-sinus.title: Cambridge NHS — Sinus lift procedures
cuh-sinus.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
cuh-sinus.scopeAndLimits: Selected lateral window, elevated lining, submembrane graft and healing assessment; simultaneous/staged placement depends on case.

aao-retainers.title: AAO — Will I need to wear retainers?
aao-retainers.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
aao-retainers.scopeAndLimits: Ongoing retention and follow-up; no promise of permanent stability.

aap-surgical.title: AAP — Surgical procedures
aap-surgical.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
aap-surgical.scopeAndLimits: Periodontal flap access, debridement and securing tissue; regeneration is conditional, not automatic.

leeds-complete.title: Leeds NHS — Complete dentures
leeds-complete.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
leeds-complete.scopeAndLimits: Impressions, jaw/bite record, wax trial, final fitting and adjustment. Local appointment intervals/charges are not imported.

ada-whitening.title: ADA — Whitening
ada-whitening.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
ada-whitening.scopeAndLimits: Natural-tooth whitening, examination, methods and sensitivity/irritation; no fixed shade, time or restoration whitening claim.

aae-trauma.title: AAE — Traumatic dental injuries
aae-trauma.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
aae-trauma.scopeAndLimits: Selected permanent-tooth avulsion: professional assessment/replantation/stabilization and follow-up, with prognosis uncertainty.

nidcr-decay.title: NIDCR — Tooth decay
nidcr-decay.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
nidcr-decay.scopeAndLimits: Non-cavitated and cavitated lesions differ; necessary restorative treatment and prevention, not universal excavation.

aao-early.title: AAO — Is there a benefit to early treatment?
aao-early.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
aao-early.scopeAndLimits: Selected early/interceptive objectives, continued growth and later assessment; not all children require early appliances.

iti-guided.title: ITI — Computer-guided implant surgery
iti-guided.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
iti-guided.scopeAndLimits: Prosthetically planned imaging/scan alignment, appropriate guide use; guide does not replace judgment or eliminate deviation.

iti-cais.title: ITI — Static computer-aided implant surgery
iti-cais.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
iti-cais.scopeAndLimits: Selected flapless access needs appropriate tissue/site assessment; no universal painless or complication-free superiority.

iti-fullarch-loading.title: ITI — Loading protocols in edentulous jaws
iti-fullarch-loading.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
iti-fullarch-loading.scopeAndLimits: Support count/distribution and loading depend on plan and stability; illustrated four/six supports are examples, not prescriptions.

iti-immediate-selection.title: ITI — Immediate placement and loading selection
iti-immediate-selection.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
iti-immediate-selection.scopeAndLimits: Selected maxillary esthetic single-tooth protocol only. Socket/soft tissue/stability may change plan; do not generalize to all sites.

leeds-periosurgery.title: Leeds NHS — Periodontal surgery
leeds-periosurgery.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
leeds-periosurgery.scopeAndLimits: Flap access and cleaning, tissue reposition/closure and later review; not instant bone regeneration.

gst-paediatric.title: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS — Decay treatment for children
gst-paediatric.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
gst-paediatric.scopeAndLimits: Primary-tooth treatment selection and crowns; local service restrictions are not general clinical rules.

kch-iv-sedation.title: King's College Hospital NHS — Intravenous sedation
kch-iv-sedation.verification: Primary source opened during this implementation task; scope is limited below.
kch-iv-sedation.scopeAndLimits: One IV sedation pathway: preparation, observation, local anaesthesia as required, recovery and discharge; no drug/dose or clinic staffing invention.

nhs-avulsion.title: NHS - Knocked-out tooth
nhs-avulsion.scopeAndLimits: Known permanent tooth, safe prompt replantation and moist storage alternative; never primary teeth; immediate dental assessment.

iadt-avulsion.title: IADT 2020 - Avulsion of permanent teeth
iadt-avulsion.scopeAndLimits: Known permanent tooth, safe prompt replantation and moist storage alternative; never primary teeth; immediate dental assessment.

iti-placement-loading-definitions.title: ITI consensus: Implant Placement and Loading Protocols
iti-placement-loading-definitions.scopeAndLimits: 2018 consensus definitions distinguish occluding immediate loading from non-occluding immediate restoration within one week. Stability and patient/site conditions govern selection.

aao-clear-aligner-therapy.title: AAO: Clear Aligner Therapy
aao-clear-aligner-therapy.scopeAndLimits: Gradual tooth movement and planned repositioning address bite as well as visible alignment. No numeric wear duration or superior outcome is inferred here.
